ambient_events: The holosign rotates a degree, as if turning to keep you in view.
Glyphs you shouldn't be able to read resolve into words, then scatter.
A grid of faint blue lines flickers into being underfoot, then thinks better of it.
The air tastes faintly of copper and ozone, the way a thought does just before you have it.
description: A vast blue lattice recedes in every direction here, a framework of light humming with orderly intent. At its center floats a holosign, a slab of soft light turning slowly on nothing. You have never seen a holosign. You know, without being told, exactly how to read it. The lattice seems to be waiting to see what you'll do with the knowing.
name: The Lattice
